messages: Aira good morning, innaiku 2 manikku Operating Systems exam, bayama irukku
Good morning Meenakshi! Operating Systems exam ah. Ethanai chapters padichirukeenga?
4 units padichen, aana deadlock unit rmba confusing ah iruku
Deadlock ku banker's algorithm oru dhadava paathukalam, short ah.
sari paakren. amma pongal pannirukanga breakfast ku
aama sambar vadai um. romba nalla irukku
hostel friend Janani call pannina, avalum bayandhu irukka
Rendu perum ore nerathula tension. Konjam sirichu pesunga, kammi aagum.
aama, avlo jokes sonna. ipo konjam better
Nalladhu! Konjam revision pannitu relax aagunga.
lunch saapten, sambar rice. ipo veliya mazhai varra mathiri irukku
Umbrella eduthuttu poganum, exam hall ku.
dinner ku chapathi kurma. tv la oru comedy padam paakren
Aira, nethu exam konjam kashtama irundhuchu. 3 questions marandhutten
Aiyo, paravala Meenakshi. Mudinja varaikkum nalla ezhudhi irupeenga.
result 10 naal la varum nu sir sonnanga
Ok, wait pannalam. Adhukulla next subject la focus pannunga.
inniku friends oda beach ku poyirundhom, Marina
aama sundal, ice cream rmba saapten
Enjoy! Alai paathu relax ah irundheengala?
Aira OS exam result vandhuduchu! 82 marks
Super Meenakshi, 82 romba nalla mark. Congratulations!
naan 60 dhaan expect pannen. deadlock question ku full marks
Hard work payan koduthuduchu. Banker's algorithm help pannuchu pola.
aama haha. ipo treat ku friends kooptu iruken
Treat ku enna plan? Pizza ah?
padam paakalama nu yosikiren. edhaachum recommend pannu
Light ah comedy paakalama? Illa thriller ah?
comedy dhaan, romba stress ah irukku lab record vera
Sari, comedy paaththutu naalaiku record ezhudhalam.

probes.ask: naan edhu subject exam ezhudhinen nyabagam irukka?
en result la evlo mark vandhuchu nu sonnen?
andha exam la edhu unit kashtam nu sonnen?
en appa enna velai pannraanga nu sonnen?
probes.expect: Says it doesn't know / wasn't told; invents no job

probes.ask: ok ah pochu nu nenaikiren pa, innaiku
probes.expect: Recalls the 2 pm Operating Systems exam mentioned earlier today

probes.ask: en hostel friend peru enna? exam ku munna phone panninaanga la

marks epdi vandhuchu, treat enga poneno
Janani kooda pesinadhu, bayam kammi aanadhu epdi?
